---
title: Curriculum vitæ
engine: knitr
freeze: false
toc: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# The CV PDF is published from the rrmrr-vita repository; this reads its
# "last modified" date at render time.
library(httr)
cv_url <- "https://www.rrmaximiliano.com/rrmrr-vita/rrmrr-vita.pdf"
hdr <- HEAD(cv_url)
pdf_date <- headers(hdr)[["last-modified"]]
last_updated <- format(
  as.POSIXct(pdf_date, format = "%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S", tz = "GMT"),
  "%B %d, %Y"
)
```

```{=html}
<div class="cv-bar">
  <span class="cv-updated">Last updated `r last_updated`</span>
  <span class="cv-actions">
    <a href="`r cv_url`" download>Download PDF ↓</a><span class="sep"> | </span><a href="`r cv_url`" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in a new tab ↗</a>
  </span>
</div>

<div class="cv-frame">
  <iframe src="`r cv_url`#view=FitH&amp;navpanes=0" title="Curriculum vitæ (PDF)"></iframe>
</div>

<p class="cv-mobile">Phones can't show the CV inside the page. <a href="`r cv_url`" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the CV ↗</a></p>
```
